articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and 3D
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code repositories, video streams, and 3D scene data in a single context window. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement on SWE-bench and near-human performance on novel video understanding tasks, marking a significant step toward general-purpose AI agents.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold Medal Level on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 scored gold-medal-level results on a held-out set of IMO 2026 problems, solving 5 out of 6 problems with full formal proofs. The system combines a chain-of-thought reasoning backbone with an AlphaProof-derived formal verification module, pushing AI mathematical reasoning to unprecedented levels.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Enters Pilot Deployment at BMW and Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla began pilot deployments of its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot at BMW manufacturing plants in South Carolina and Amazon fulfillment centers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and can autonomously learn new pick-and-place tasks via a few-shot imitation learning pipeline, reducing onboarding time from days to under an hour.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Construction Autonomy Stack
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics officially launched the commercial Atlas platform with an integrated construction autonomy stack developed in partnership with Hyundai Engineering. The system can autonomously perform rebar tying, drywall carrying, and site inspection using LiDAR-vision fusion, targeting a market debut in Q1 2027 with pre-orders already exceeding 500 units.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' Framework to Mitigate Jailbreaks Across Foundation Models
articles.summary: Anthropic published a new open-source framework called Constitutional Classifiers that layers lightweight, constitutionally-trained classifier heads on top of any foundation model to detect and block adversarial jailbreak attempts. In red-team evaluations, the system reduced successful attacks by 93% with less than 2% impact on helpful response rates, offering a model-agnostic safety layer.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm GAA Process Node, Powering Next-Gen AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production has started on its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around transistor architecture at its Kaohsiung fab. The node delivers a 25% performance gain and 35% power reduction versus N2, with Apple, NVIDIA, and AMD expected to be lead customers for chips taping out in early 2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate First Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum announced they have achieved below-threshold fault-tolerant operations on logical qubits using Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion system combined with Microsoft's topological error correction codes. The milestone demonstrates sustained logical error rates of 10^-8 per operation, clearing a key barrier to practical quantum computing at scale.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing with On-Device Foundation Models
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, with funding from Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Intel Capital. The company plans to build a dedicated humanoid manufacturing facility in Texas and deploy on-device multimodal foundation models that enable its Figure 03 robots to perform complex manipulation tasks without cloud connectivity.
